findings.summary: Save precondition requires a nonblank birthday, contradicting the birthday being optional everywhere else.
findings.evidence: preconditions: [Owner session, Nonblank name, Nonblank birthday] vs 'Optional birthday as month and day' and C.webapp.contact.save 'an optional month-day birthday'

findings.summary: Birthday field typed as local-date (requires a year) conflicts with month-day birthday where year may be blank.
findings.evidence: { name: birthday, type: local-date, optional: true } vs 'Optional birthday as month and day; the year may be left blank'

findings.summary: Birthday field cardinality 'exactly one' is inconsistent with sibling optional ChannelFields and the screen description listing it as optional.
findings.evidence: cardinality: exactly one; description: Optional birthday as month and day
